d: Bihar men panchayat chunav ko lekar rajy sarkar ke mantri Deepak Prakash ne aham jankari di hai. unhonne bataya ki philhal panchayton ke parisiman ka kam chal raha hai. parisiman pura hone ke bad chunav karae jaenge. mantri ke mutabik, parisiman aur chunav ki prakriya nirvachan aayog ke star par puri honi hai aur chunav ki samay-sima bhi aayog hi tay karega. aise men panchayat chunav ki tarikhon ko lekar ab nirvachan aayog ke agle kadam par najar rahegi.
